automation.description: Used by the recorder round-trip test: in an already signed-in PrimeFaces (tablet UX/UI) session, a user opens links in new windows, closes them, goes back and reloads, while the recorder writes a script of what was done, which is then replayed.

interaction.name: New windows, back and refresh
interaction.description: Opens a new lookup value in a new window, makes it, opens the List Grid Fixture in a window nested in it and checks the value is listed, closes both, reloads and opens a PDF in a new window, then checks Back and Reload throw away an unsaved edit and deletes the lookup value.

method.comment: A lookup value made in a new window, and the List Grid Fixture opened by its URL in a window nested in it

navigateLink.text: Open a new lookup value in a new window

method.comment: Back in the first window: its list grid shows the new value once the page is reloaded
A PDF in a new window, which records nothing: it is closed when the next step is in this window

navigateLink.text: Open a PDF in a new window
